other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered woman construction worker under APBOCWWB, or the wife of a registered male worker, or their daughter.
Benefit is available only for the first two live births.
The worker must have completed at least one year of registration with the board before applying.
The claim must be submitted within six months of childbirth.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹20,000 to support women workers, their wives, and daughters during maternity.
